constants.name: Pi
constants.source: ISO 80000-2:2019, mathematical constants (pi, the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter)
constants.note: stored symbolically as pi^1, never as a fraction, so deg is exactly pi/180

constants.name: Planck constant
constants.source: BIPM SI Brochure, 9th ed. (2019), ch. 2, Table 1 (defining constants): h = 6.626 070 15e-34 J s

constants.name: Elementary charge
constants.source: BIPM SI Brochure, 9th ed. (2019), ch. 2, Table 1 (defining constants): e = 1.602 176 634e-19 C

constants.name: Boltzmann constant
constants.source: BIPM SI Brochure, 9th ed. (2019), ch. 2, Table 1 (defining constants): k = 1.380 649e-23 J/K

constants.name: Avogadro constant
constants.source: BIPM SI Brochure, 9th ed. (2019), ch. 2, Table 1 (defining constants): avogadro_constant = 6.022 140 76e23 1/mol

constants.name: Speed of light in vacuum
constants.source: BIPM SI Brochure, 9th ed. (2019), ch. 2, Table 1 (defining constants): c = 299 792 458 m s^-1
constants.note: exact by the 1983 definition of the metre and the 2019 SI

constants.name: Molar gas constant
constants.source: R = avogadro_constant boltzmann_constant, the product of two defining constants (BIPM SI Brochure, 9th ed. (2019), ch. 2, Table 1): 6.022 140 76e23 1/mol x 1.380 649e-23 J/K = 8.314 462 618 153 24 J/(mol K)
constants.note: exact: the product of the exact avogadro_constant and boltzmann_constant, 602214076 x 1380649 = 831446261815324
